Sub Scenario()
  Dim x As Integer
  x = 5
  Dim total As Double
  total = 0
  Do While x > 0
    total = total + x
    x = x - 1
  Loop
  Range("A1").Value = total
End Sub

description: Do While countdown from 3 into A1 (extra)
vbaSource:
Sub Scenario()
  Dim x As Integer
  x = 3
  Dim total As Double
  total = 0
  Do While x > 0
    total = total + x
    x = x - 1
  Loop
  Range("A1").Value = total
End Sub
